mapper.sql: SELECT sv.id FROM story_versions sv JOIN projects p ON p.id = sv.project_id WHERE p.id = #{projectId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND p.owner_id = #{ownerId} AND p.archived_at IS NULL AND sv.status IN ('ACTIVE', 'DRAFT') ORDER BY CASE WHEN sv.status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, sv.version_number DESC, sv.id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.select:
WITH current_story AS (
) SELECT c.story_version_id, c.id AS chapter_id, c.order_index, c.title, c.row_version, c.source_hash, c.source_text AS subtitle_text, NULL::uuid AS media_plan_id, NULL::integer AS media_plan_revision, CASE p.image_aspect_ratio WHEN 'RATIO_9_16' THEN '9:16' WHEN 'RATIO_1_1' THEN '1:1' WHEN 'RATIO_4_3' THEN '4:3' WHEN 'RATIO_3_4' THEN '3:4' ELSE '16:9' END AS aspect_ratio, narration.duration_ms AS audio_duration_ms, narration.storage_key AS audio_storage_key, narration.size_bytes AS audio_size_bytes, narration.checksum AS audio_checksum, narration.narration_request_id, narration.narration_asset_id, narration.narration_alignment_id, narration.subtitle_spans_json, COALESCE(narration.duration_ms, NULLIF(c.estimated_duration_ms, 0), scene_duration.duration_ms, 0) AS fallback_duration_ms, COALESCE(storyboard_counts.beat_count, 0) AS beat_count, COALESCE(storyboard_counts.ready_beat_count, 0) AS ready_beat_count FROM chapters c JOIN current_story cs ON cs.id = c.story_version_id JOIN projects p ON p.id = #{projectId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT nr.id AS narration_request_id, na.id AS narration_asset_id, alignment.id AS narration_alignment_id, alignment.subtitle_spans_json, pa.storage_key, na.size_bytes, na.checksum, na.duration_ms FROM narration_requests nr JOIN narration_assets na ON na.narration_request_id = nr.id JOIN project_assets pa ON pa.id = na.project_asset_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT nal.id, nal.spans_json::text AS subtitle_spans_json FROM narration_alignments nal WHERE nal.narration_asset_id = na.id AND nal.source_hash = nr.source_hash ORDER BY nal.created_at DESC, nal.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) alignment ON TRUE WHERE nr.project_id = #{projectId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND nr.chapter_id = c.id AND nr.chapter_row_version = c.row_version AND nr.source_hash = c.source_hash AND pa.status = 'ACTIVE' AND pa.storage_key IS NOT NULL AND na.duration_ms > 0 ORDER BY nr.created_at DESC, nr.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) narration ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.duration_seconds) * 1000, 0)::bigint AS duration_ms FROM scenes s WHERE s.chapter_id = c.id AND s.storyboard_revision_id = c.current_storyboard_revision_id ) scene_duration ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS beat_count, COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM production_beat_media_selections pbms JOIN media_assets ma ON ma.id = pbms.media_asset_id WHERE pbms.project_id = #{projectId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND pbms.visual_beat_id = vb.id AND ma.account_id = #{ownerId} AND ma.status = 'READY' AND ma.deleted_at IS NULL AND ma.asset_type IN ('IMAGE', 'VIDEO') AND ma.size_bytes > 0 AND ma.sha256 IS NOT NULL ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM media_assets ma WHERE ma.id = vb.preview_media_asset_id AND ma.account_id = #{ownerId} AND ma.status = 'READY' AND ma.deleted_at IS NULL AND ma.asset_type IN ('IMAGE', 'VIDEO') AND ma.size_bytes > 0 AND ma.sha256 IS NOT NULL ) )::int AS ready_beat_count FROM scenes s JOIN visual_beats vb ON vb.scene_id = s.id WHERE s.chapter_id = c.id AND s.storyboard_revision_id = c.current_storyboard_revision_id ) storyboard_counts ON TRUE WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY c.order_index ASC, c.id ASC

WITH current_story AS (
), current_beats AS ( SELECT c.id AS chapter_id, c.order_index AS chapter_order_index, s.order_index AS scene_index, vb.order_index AS beat_index, vb.id AS visual_beat_id, vb.title, vb.visual_intent, COALESCE(vb.camera_movement, 'NONE') AS camera_movement, vb.audio_start_ms, vb.audio_end_ms, CASE WHEN vb.audio_start_ms IS NOT NULL AND vb.audio_end_ms IS NOT NULL AND vb.audio_end_ms > vb.audio_start_ms THEN vb.audio_end_ms - vb.audio_start_ms ELSE NULL END AS audio_duration_ms, vb.preview_media_asset_id FROM chapters c JOIN current_story cs ON cs.id = c.story_version_id JOIN scenes s ON s.chapter_id = c.id AND s.storyboard_revision_id = c.current_storyboard_revision_id JOIN visual_beats vb ON vb.scene_id = s.id WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL ) SELECT cb.chapter_id, cb.chapter_order_index, NULL::uuid AS media_plan_id, NULL::integer AS media_plan_revision, cb.scene_index, cb.beat_index, cb.visual_beat_id, COALESCE(cb.title, CONCAT('Beat ', cb.beat_index + 1)) AS title, cb.visual_intent, cb.camera_movement, 'GENERATE_NEW' AS asset_strategy, cb.audio_start_ms, cb.audio_end_ms, cb.audio_duration_ms, COALESCE(chosen.media_asset_id, preview.media_asset_id) AS media_asset_id, COALESCE(chosen.media_type, preview.media_type) AS media_type, COALESCE(chosen.storage_mode, preview.storage_mode) AS storage_mode, COALESCE(chosen.source_duration_ms, preview.source_duration_ms) AS source_duration_ms, CASE WHEN chosen.media_asset_id IS NOT NULL THEN chosen.fit_mode ELSE 'TRIM' END AS fit_mode, CASE WHEN chosen.media_asset_id IS NOT NULL THEN chosen.trim_start_ms ELSE 0 END AS trim_start_ms, (chosen.media_asset_id IS NOT NULL) AS media_selection_active, COALESCE(chosen.storage_key, preview.storage_key) AS storage_key, COALESCE(chosen.size_bytes, preview.size_bytes) AS size_bytes, COALESCE(chosen.checksum, preview.checksum) AS checksum FROM current_beats cb LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT ma.id AS media_asset_id, ma.asset_type AS media_type, ma.storage_mode, ma.duration_ms AS source_duration_ms, pbms.fit_mode, pbms.trim_start_ms, ma.storage_key, ma.size_bytes, ma.sha256 AS checksum FROM production_beat_media_selections pbms JOIN media_assets ma ON ma.id = pbms.media_asset_id WHERE pbms.project_id = #{projectId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND pbms.visual_beat_id = cb.visual_beat_id AND ma.account_id = #{ownerId} AND ma.status = 'READY' AND ma.deleted_at IS NULL AND ma.asset_type IN ('IMAGE', 'VIDEO') AND ma.size_bytes > 0 AND ma.sha256 IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1 ) chosen ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT ma.id AS media_asset_id, ma.asset_type AS media_type, ma.storage_mode, ma.duration_ms AS source_duration_ms, ma.storage_key, ma.size_bytes, ma.sha256 AS checksum FROM media_assets ma WHERE ma.id = cb.preview_media_asset_id AND ma.account_id = #{ownerId} AND ma.status = 'READY' AND ma.deleted_at IS NULL AND ma.asset_type IN ('IMAGE', 'VIDEO') AND ma.size_bytes > 0 AND ma.sha256 IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1 ) preview ON TRUE ORDER BY cb.chapter_order_index ASC, cb.chapter_id ASC, cb.scene_index ASC, cb.beat_index ASC, cb.visual_beat_id ASC
